reason: Wrong vertical and far too large: IntegriChain is a Nordic Capital PE-backed biopharma market-access data/SaaS platform (611 employees, ~$30M revenue, Philadelphia, founded 2005, 400+ pharma customers) with a full in-house technology org — not a $2M-$20M low-voltage integrator or electrical contractor adding a technology line to buildings it already serves. No line in the fresh 26-role feed describes missing senior technology leadership, a new low-voltage or managed-Wi-Fi service line, vendor selection for building systems, estimating bottlenecks, or converting installs to recurring service plans — so there is no quotable line redescribing the problem he fixes.
